sourceRefs: Human/Ops reviewer was automatically replaced by Codex2 before exact-head approval
Codex and Codex2 share one ChatGPT account
bound-review reassignment and unavailable reviewer paths

acceptance: Start from current origin/dev; reference #4414 and #4445 as evidence only and do not rewrite V3 failure-record behavior.

For a task in review or review_approved with a valid exact-head review binding or pending reviewer handoff, automatic provider/lane recovery must preserve the reviewer identity; it must block or retain the handoff rather than substitute an unavailable reviewer.
The identity-equivalence policy must reject Codex/Codex2 as an owner/reviewer pair for approval or merge gating, even when their agent labels differ.
Normal unbound task reassignment remains available only to a genuinely independent reviewer lane; no broad scheduler redesign.

Regression tests reproduce #4445: owner Codex, reviewer Human/Ops, exact head binding, Human/Ops unavailable, Codex2 selectable; assert reviewer is not changed, approval cannot be created, and no merge-ready state results.
Regression tests cover a valid independent reassignment for an unbound task and forged/stale binding negatives.
Do not modify .orchestrator/config.json, live runtime JSON, retry thresholds, provider readiness policy, deployment configuration, V3 failure-record schema, or product tasks.

Use a clean governed worktree and task branch task/SUP-REVIEW-IDENTITY-BOUND-REASSIGN-GUARD-20260802; PR target dev; run focused and complete supervisor/ai-status regressions plus diff/trailer checks.
Require Gemini exact-head review and protected merge after all checks; rollout is source merge only and rollback is revert of this follow-up merge.
